implementation_summary: AI CSS is scoped under .qa-preview-root and rendered in a wrapper div. The note sits outside the wrapper and is pinned with !important at a higher-specificity selector. The wrapper is contained with overflow hidden, contain paint and flow-root. Selectors targeting html, body, :root, [role], a leading * or a leading combinator are refused. position:absolute and z-index are refused. The style hash is computed over the final style text, so DEC-008 still holds.
tests_proposed: Optional browser test: render a hostile preview in Chromium and assert the note's bounding box and that elementFromPoint returns the note
evidence: packages/core/tests/audit-preview-sanitize.test.ts: describe 'hostile CSS cannot hide or cover the note (SEC-002)'
risks: AI CSS using * at the start of a selector or body/html selectors is now dropped, so some generated previews lose global resets and body backgrounds; this is intended by the correction.
Inline style attributes are not scoped, but they cannot reach the note: absolute, fixed, sticky and z-index are refused, and the wrapper clips overflow.
Preview HTML structure changed (extra wrapper div), so any consumer matching on the body markup, such as BE-604 Shared Link pages, should be re-checked.
handoff: Previews and shared pages rendered via renderPreviewDocument now carry the .qa-preview-root wrapper. styleHashes and previewCspForHtml work unchanged. cleanStylesheet(css, scope=false) is backward compatible.
